message.body: Hi Priya — thanks for the detail. I can reproduce the redirect loop and have asked engineering to look at the SAML callback. Could you tell me which identity provider you use?
We use Okta. Happens in Chrome and Safari alike.
Hi Marcus, happy to help. Could you confirm the VAT/tax ID that should appear with the new address?
Hi Sofia, we're treating this as a priority. The sync worker is restarting now; I'll confirm once records catch up.
Still nothing new on our side. Any ETA?
Love this idea, Aiko! I've logged it with the product team and will let you know when it's scheduled.
Hi Daniel — it looks like your seats are fully used. Could you check the Billing > Seats page and tell me what you see?
Hi Priya, I can raise the limit to 600 req/min for the import window. Can you share the date and time range?
Invoices live under Settings > Billing > History. I've also emailed Q2 and Q3 PDFs to you.
Found it: a queue backlog on our side. It's been cleared and deliveries are real-time again.
All set — your login email is updated. You'll get a confirmation link shortly.
Apologies for the double charge. I've refunded the duplicate; it'll show in 3–5 business days.
The maintenance left a stale cache. I've flushed it — please reload and let us know if the widgets load.
Working again, thanks for the quick fix.

note.body: Matches the regression from release 4.12 — callback URL casing. Pinged #eng-auth.
Worker crash-looping on a malformed payload from Lumen's tenant. Eng is patching; customer is VIP.
Approved by Sarah for temporary 600 rpm. Needs reset after next Friday.
Duplicate was caused by a retry on the payment provider; Finance notified.
